items.title: Harman India in Talks with 2W, CV Makers to Supply Infotainment Systems
items.summary: Harman India is in discussions with multiple two-wheeler and commercial vehicle manufacturers to supply in-vehicle infotainment (IVI) and cockpit domain controller (CDC) systems, according to a senior company executive. This would mark Harman Automotive’s expansion beyond its traditional passenger vehicle business in India.

items.title: Volkswagen CEO to face employees amid reports of 100,000 job cuts, plant closures
items.summary: This overhaul aims to address competition from Chinese electric vehicle makers. The company seeks to improve performance and maintain market competitiveness.

items.title: Volvo Cars sees stronger second half despite steep China decline, rising costs
items.summary: Sales in the world's largest auto market slumped a sharper-than-expected 35 per cent, dragging Volvo's operating margin down to 1.1 per cent from 1.6 per cent.

items.title: Volvo Cars sees stronger second half despite steep China decline, rising costs
items.summary: Volvo Cars reported a sharp 35% sales decline in China, squeezing margins and dragging shares lower, while warning of rising raw material costs.

items.title: JSW MG Motor lines up two new-energy SUVs for FY27 launch, plans ₹1,400 cr investment
items.summary: The company will introduce these 4.3-metre-plus models on its newly-unveiled multi-energy platform ADAPT that will be localised for the Indian market. The ₹1,400 crore investment commitment will support the upcoming product offensive and localisation roadmap.

items.title: Gabriel India to Invest ₹180 Crore in New Capacity, Automation in FY27
items.summary: Gabriel India plans to invest around ₹180 crore in its standalone business in FY27, with the proposed spending covering a new plant at Hosur and capacity expansion across some of its existing facilities. The company expects a large part of its two-wheeler growth to come from the new Hosur facility, Atul Jaggi, Group President, ANAND Group, and Managing Director of Gabriel India, told Autocar Professional.

items.title: Auto ancillary sector growth outlook positive, but near-term margin pressure likely: Report
items.summary: India’s auto bearings and ancillary sector is poised for strong medium-term growth, driven by rising bearing content per vehicle, robust demand across PV, CV, and 2W segments, and steady support from railways and industrial sectors like wind, cement, and steel. However, near-term profitability may be impacted by input cost volatility, higher raw material and energy prices, and transition-related expenses.

items.summary: Amara Raja Advanced Cell Technologies has inaugrated its Customer Qualification Plant at the company's Giga Corridor in Telangana. The facility represents a 500 crore rupee capital investment and functions as part of a broader 9,500 crore rupee, 16 gigawatt-hour factory development program.

items.title: CEAT to Invest ₹1,205 Crore to Expand Two-Wheeler Tyre Capacity by 66%
items.summary: CEAT plans to invest around ₹1,205 crore to expand its two-wheeler tyre manufacturing capacity by about 66% as the existing capacity at its Nagpur plant nears full utilisation. The tyre maker will add around 53,000 tyres a day in phases by the end of FY31.

items.title: PeakAmp, Curve Electric partner on EV battery collection and recycling
items.summary: Under the multi-year agreement, PeakAmp will manage battery collection, recycling, exchange and regulatory compliance for Curve Electric's e-bike operations.

items.title: Hungary investigates deal with China's BYD carmaker after ex-foreign minister takes job there
items.summary: While serving in government, Szijjarto was instrumental in securing foreign investments in Hungary from Chinese companies, including his now-employer BYD, which received considerable state subsidies during his tenure.

items.title: Shakti Pumps Invests ₹5 Crore in EV Mobility Subsidiary
items.summary: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has invested ₹5 crore in its wholly owned subsidiary, Shakti EV Mobility Private Limited, according to a regulatory filing submitted to the stock exchanges. The capital infusion was executed through the cash subscription of 50 lakh equity shares possessing a face value of ₹10 each.

items.title: No eviction, only show-cause notice to Rajesh Exports in PLI battery scheme
items.summary: The MoHI is preparing to issue a show-cause notice to ACC Energy Storage in the next few days. The decision against evicting ACC Energy Storage came after the ministry sought legal opinion on the feasibility of evicting a beneficiary which has bagged its place after a global bidding process.
